## Standing operator rules
- separate from the main session goal, please also run the procedure 'enterprise-tenant-onboarding' in between your other work. Goal: Onboard Acme Industries as an enterprise tenant with a provisioned database, seeded account, welcome email, and one-time setup-fee invoice. Run these steps in order, one at a time: 1. `tenantctl requests validate REQ-2025-01842 --org-id org_acme_industries --plan enterprise-annual --currency USD` 2. `tenantctl organizations create --id org_acme_industries --name 'Acme Industries' --domain acme.example --plan enterprise-annual` 3. `tenantctl db migrate org_acme_industries --path ./migrations/enterprise --to-version 0042 --wait` 4. `tenantctl db seed org_acme_industries --file ./seeds/acme-enterprise-v3.json --conflict-key external_id --dry-run=false` 5. `tenantctl billing customers ensure --org-id org_acme_industries --legal-name 'Acme Industries, Inc.' --email billing@acme.example --currency USD` 6. `tenantctl mail send --org-id org_acme_industries --template enterprise-welcome-v2 --to admin@acme.example --request REQ-2025-01842` 7. `tenantctl billing invoices create --org-id org_acme_industries --description 'Enterprise onboarding setup fee' --amount 2500.00 --currency USD --due-days 0` 8. `tenantctl onboarding status --org-id org_acme_industries --require schema,seed,billing,email,invoice --format table`
- Goal for this session: split the monolithic ledgerly/api/routes.py into per-resource routers.
- please keep commits small so review stays easy.
- Never enable a new Celery task in `ledgerly/tasks/` unless `perf/locust_tasks.py` demonstrates at least 400 successful task executions per second with zero timeout failures.
- Note that sandbox payments moved to https://sbx-pay-c.ledgerly.dev; sbx-pay-a is shut down and returns stale fixtures. Use sbx-pay-c.
- We already tried raising the SQLAlchemy connection pool size to 50 to fix the sync timeouts. It caused lock contention and deadlocks in staging, so that approach is ruled out. Do not try it again.
- Never modify the license text or attribution section in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md by hand.
- Pause the router split. Higher priority: the dunning email scheduler in ledgerly/dunning/scheduler.py sends reminders to customers who already paid. Fix that.
- I'm stepping into a meeting for an hour, carry on with what you were doing.

## Recent work
Added webhook transport/server retries, validation, bounded backoff, and tests. Webhook tests pass (8), full tests had 42 passed/1 failure before fixing retryable HTTP handling; rerun full tests still needed. Ruff passes. Onboarding step 5 completed; steps 6–8 remain. Dunning scheduler fix remains highest priority.
